method.meter: FFmpeg7.1.5 ebur128 / EBU R128 / BS.1770 K-weighted stereo energy
method.integratedGate: 400ms blocks,100ms step, absolute -70LUFS and relative -10LU; implementation ffmpeg ebur128
method.momentary: 400ms,100ms reporting; no loudness gating on displayed M
method.shortTerm: 3s,100ms reporting; first incomplete windows excluded; P10/P90 uses values >= max(-70,I-20) (descriptive selection, not Integrated gating)
method.lra: EBU LRA:3s short-term distribution; absolute -70 and relative -20LU gate;10th–95th percentiles; short jingles indicative only
method.truePeak: FFmpeg ebur128 peak=true resampling; analysis rounding0.1dB, not hardware voltage
method.spectrum: Welch Hann8192 samples at44100Hz,50% overlap; band fraction of20Hz–20kHz unweighted energy; stereo mean power
method.mono: arithmetic(L+R)/2 copied to two channels for equal channel-count loudness comparison; not a measured device downmix
method.speakerFilter: mono + cascaded2nd-order Butterworth HP and LP, forward causal linear filter, no level normalization; generic hypotheses, NOT iPhone-specific curves or measured outputs
method.sections: intro/end=min(8s,duration/3); normal middle; climax=max3s short-term window (numerical loudest window, not an authored emotional climax)
method.sourcePreservation: 64 SHA256 verified; no source writes; AAC padding trimmed only in analysis to playback catalog period
method.maskingLimit: mixed-master spectra cannot isolate instruments or solve perceptual masking; no inferred per-instrument correction
